events.title: Rates And Fuel Costs Framed The May 7 Open
events.summary: A retroactive context note for 7 May 2026. US labour resilience kept the Fed path in focus, while aviation fuel and gasoline-pressure stories made banks, rate-sensitive sectors, aviation, and consumption the India checks.
events.reason: Created after the fact on 9 May 2026 from verified article-level sources. This is not the live 7:15 AM edition and does not recreate intraday trading levels.
events.indiaPublisherCoverage: Full India-source gate: Not cleared; this backfill is global-cue context, not a full India-source briefing.
contextLines: Fed-path pressure was the cleanest macro read: stronger private payrolls reduced urgency for rate cuts and kept yield-sensitive India sectors on watch.
Aviation fuel pressure was relevant for IndiGo, SpiceJet, OMCs, and inflation expectations, but it needed domestic sector breadth before becoming a broad-index call.
Consumer fuel stress mattered as a demand-risk cue; FMCG, autos, retail lenders, and Bank Nifty breadth were the confirmation checks.
watchItems: Watch US 10Y direction and Bank Nifty VWAP before trusting any risk-on move.
Track aviation, OMC, and consumer-sector breadth after the first range.
